anya: Quick question — I transfer teams (and office) on 2026-11-17 from US to EU. How is PTO prorated for the quarter and does the year-end blackout (Dec 24-31) affect my accrual or carryover?
people-ops: Congrats on the move! :tada: Short answers: accruals are prorated by days in company service during the accrual period; carryover caps still apply per region. The year-end blackout doesn't pause accruals but you can't schedule PTO during the shutdown window unless approved.
payroll: FYI payroll cutoffs matter for proration if transfer crosses payroll periods. If the transfer date lands after payroll close for that month, the old office's accrual will be applied and the new office's proration will start next cycle. Can you confirm exact transfer timestamp?
anya: transfer day is 2026-11-17 10:00 PT (moving to EU office timezone). I can ask for official timestamp if needed.
people-ops: that's fine — for policy math we use local transfer date, but payroll will reconcile by payroll cutoff. Example proration we use:```
Full quarterly accrual (US) = 6 days
Days in quarter before transfer = 27
Days in quarter total = 92
Prorated = round(6 * 27 / 92, 2) = 1.76 -> 1.8 days (policy rounds to nearest 0.1)
```
people-ops: After transfer you start accruing under EU policy rates for the remaining days of that quarter. Carryover: both regions share the same company-wide max carryover of 10 days unless local law mandates otherwise; we apply the stricter rule.
david_mgr: My team will be on rotation over holiday shutdown. If anya's carryover would push them >10 days, can we auto-approve using an exception so they can take those days before the blackout?
people-ops: Exceptions during shutdown are rare since the point of the blackout is coverage. We can do one-off manager exceptions for business-critical cases but need: (1) manager sign-off, (2) payroll approval for payout vs. carryover, (3) confirmation that coverage is arranged. Submit using the /pto-exception form and tag @people-ops.
payroll: If the request is to payout excess days instead of using carryover, payroll needs the manager approval before payroll cutoff (Nov 25 payroll close for Dec accrual). Otherwise the carryover is applied and subject to the 10-day cap.
people-ops-bot: Policy link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/pto-proration-and-blackout — includes the proration table, rounding rules, and regional overrides. Automated note: documents updated 2026-07-01.
anya: Thanks — filing /pto-exception now and will coordinate coverage with david. cc @people-ops
people-ops: Perfect. We'll review once you submit the form. If payroll needs anything else we'll ping. :white_check_mark:
anya: Awesome, appreciate it!
